The Petitioner has served a copy of the Petition on the Respondents, and notice regarding the filing of this Petition has also been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act, 2003 (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”). No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notice published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. None of the Respondents have filed their reply in the instant Petition. 7. The hearing in the matter was held on 26.12.2024 and 25.2.2025. The order in the matter was reserved on 25.2.2025. This order is being issued considering the submissions made by the Petitioner in the Petition vide affidavits dated 8.12.2023, 7.5.2024, and 9.1.2025. 8. Having heard the Petitioner’s representatives and having perused the material on record, we proceed to dispose of the Petition. 17. The Petitioner has submitted that compensation was paid as per the actual/in line with the Guidelines issued by the MoP/ respective State Government and as decided by competent authorities. Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 9.1.2025, has furnished a letter dated 29.5.2023, which was written by the Petitioner to the Deputy Commissioner (Roing) to resolve the ROW issue between locations 25/0 and 27/0. Based on the Petitioner’s request, the order was issued by 42. We have considered the Petitioner’s submission. On perusal of the documents placed on record, it is observed that the Petitioner had uploaded the proposal on the concerned portal of the forest department on 20.8.2021 and took up the matter effectivelywith the concerned authorities of the forest department vide letters dated 30.8.2021 and 3.12.2021. After completing the process at various stages of approval, Stage-I Forest Clearance was accorded on 2.12.2023, and subsequently, the site was officially handed over after completion of demarcation of forest land by the concerned Forest Department of the Government of Assam vide letter dated 16.2.2023. 45. The Petitioner has claimed a delay of 730 days from 29.7.2021 to 29.5.2023 on account of various ROW issues encountered by the Petitioner during the construction of the transmission line. Further, the Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 7.5.2024, has also submitted that the tower foundation, erection, and stringing work were hampered due to various RoW issues. The Petitioner has also submitted the location-wise details of various RoW issues which are summarized as follows: 46. We have considered the Petitioner’s submission. Having perused the documents on record, we are of the view that the Petitioner faced various RoW issues in Arunachal Pradesh and Assam at different locations under Tinsukia and Lower Dibang Valley districts. The Petitioner took up the matter effectively with the concerned administrative, police, and forest authorities through letters dated 18.12.2021, 20.4.2022, 16.6.2022, 1.8.2022, 9.3.2023, and 29.5.2023 to intervene in the RoW issues and resolve the same for early completion of work. In response, the concerned authorities also took appropriate steps vide letters dated 27.1.2022, 31.1.2022, 11.2.2022, 26.9.2022, and 30.5.2023. - _(d) Liabilities to meet award of arbitration or for compliance of the directions or order of any statutory authority or order or decree of any court of law;_ # 79.
